fields.System.Title: INV-504 — Report orphaned reservations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want a nightly report of reservations with no live order
line, so that stock made invisible by a missed release path is found in days rather than
months.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a reservation whose order line is cancelled, shipped, or missing, then it
  • appears on the report.
  • - Given the report, then it shows product, location, quantity, age, and the order it
  • claims to belong to.
  • - Given a mismatch between the sum of reservation rows and qty_reserved on a balance,
  • then it is reported as a discrepancy.
  • - Given any finding, then the report alerts a human rather than only writing a log line.
  • - Given the report, then it does not automatically release anything — a human decides.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, reservation |
| Risks | Reservation leak ([doc 09 §5.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); orphans from no cross-module FKs ([doc 02 §4](../../../docs/02-architecture-overview.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
